create_ACDumper_evaluator: create an ACDumper evaluator instance for a dataset with distributed evaluation and output directory
run_get_matches: run get_matches to compute boolean overlap matrix between object masks and part masks with a threshold
process_instances_AC: process detection instances to extract object-part features, bounding boxes, and attributes for an image
evaluate_AC_predictions: evaluate and save AC predictions to a pth file across distributed processes using ACDumper
reset_ACDumper: reset the ACDumper predictions list to clear accumulated results before a new evaluation run
